title: Quentin and the Portrait
author: Ada Winterbourne
blurb: Rosalind Kavanagh, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
